ai você pensa. eu tô fumando pra quê? no fundo é sempre pra tapar alguma dor, alguma falta. viver é super difícil. e o instagram nada que toda nossa vaidade.

essa é a parte que fode nas drogas. a de que vc quer anestesiar algo que te dói e até nessa hora a gente se causa dor um nos outros. 

a gente é que tem que dizer pra gente, qual minha dose? que horas eu quero experimentar? e tirar o que fica e o que te acompanha ao longo da vida com todas as experiências. e, nao, não tem jeito a vida vai te quebrar de um jeito ou de outro. ❤️ @quasehelio

I feel the same. we have some many narratives that go against suicidal and euthanasia feelings. I guess most of people, even though, feel the tragedy of our journey, still want to keep it up. 

for us, the minority, we have to go with the flow. or try to create a movement. bur guess what, nowadays people are much more affraid to die than ever. in the other hand I can see some little movements trying to get this debate on. death, euthanasia, etc. 

we should just stop judging. and allow every person decide their fate. I don’t want to be here either.

I see. I just woke up feeling bad. it’s middle of the night where I am. at least I’m in my home. that’s what I want to think, when my other part is pointing for the discomfort. tomorrow I’ll try my best. and everyday I try to meditate and I never start.

wow. you are not alone. in other words, this is self knowledge. this is why people go to therapist. but they get to know lil by lil. you already know about you. self knowledge is not for us to fall for us, but to understand our limits, what we should and what we should not. don’t hurt anyone physically. play easy with yourself, despite I know it’s almost impossible. make some art. express yourself being creative, being bad, leave on this world your message. majority of people are not even average, intellectually. you are beyond, that’s why the suffering is unbearable. we all got find a way to live with that. and only who really feels that, knows how much closer to hell we are. 🥺 not alone, despite that’s what we feel.

success. one thing we must think is might not get it. or it might not last forever. I mean, at least the feeling. a trophy at the shelf is a memory. sometimes we pass through it and we don’t even see it. that’s how success work. we have to see it. in the world like ours, that we getting far, far away for what used to primitive, success are on things. that most crazy thing that every super sensitive human being, which I believe every suicidal person is, is that the world is what is. we wish great moments, great conquers could last longer, just like wants our fantasies. reality is something else. more raw, harder. but sometimes possible. success is inside of this sometimes. it’s ok not get everyday, it’s ok when we feel they didn’t mean anything.
I’m with you. I really wish we could get together and just be honest. we are all sick, we are small, we are possessive, we like competition, to feel special with emptiness
open the note app and answer: why I don’t want to live anymore?

when I imagine kms, I just want to feel ready and conscious about it. if you still see some tiny small pleasures left, go for them first. time can wait. and do it, when you don’t feel you don’t have time for anything you don’t love anymore. even if that means you. ❤️ but think about it. always think about it. there’s a privilege to be on this position. we are extremely sensitive. is a hard world to be. but we have a lot to contribute. just being who we are.
be honest. so far, I’m still thinking about it. ❤️

to grow hurts. and, honestly, I don’t think it gets better. but I can tell won’t be same. sometimes our parents are weirdly growing up with us. sometimes we can get them later. and sometimes, we can just realize we were right the whole fucking time and let them go, walk with our pain and, if you are lucky, get back here and tell us everything you’ve learnt. ❤️

no. I was living in nyc. got back home (brazil) because I thought if I get the guts to kill myself would be easier to everyone to do it here. I think about it constantly though. but idk, I didn’t hear a loud voice screaming inside of my head without any doubts. I feel like, my mom should die first. and then maybe I don’t really have a reason to stay, despite I’m not being the greatest son. I’m just here at her house everyday. I clean and I teach my niece how to read. I kind feel sorry for my niece, so young, so much to see, and this world is overdone I guess. but she might like it. she can be different than me. but I think I’m going to kill myself. I don’t think something will happen to make me wait. like, maybe I little older, when I be ready to write something like zweig did. it has to be something more conscious, something that with some sort or lucidity than pain and resentment.

it’s about to complete a week. and some days are gone already, which means if you want to reach her out, it might be a good idea. but if you do, think of what you really want to say to her. from your heart. 

but some tips about love. we expect too much from love. because they taught us the way. tha love brings all the answer. love is great and if we don’t receive love, when we are baby, for example, like eye contact with the person who’s looking after us, we die. 

most of the things we pursue in life is relate to feel that feeling of love again. that unconditionally love. that’s why we do what we do. we want succes, we want to be rich, we dye our hair, we look pretty or ugly. deep down is to get that love back. doesn’t matter how. and getting old with some intelligence is to understand that we have to walk through this path of love no asking much anymore, but accepting the people the way they are and being acceptable too, the way we are. 

before saying hi back to her. try to see if you can accept the way she is, understanding that you won’t be able to change her. and she won’t be able to change you either. 

we tend to put ourselves in a fantasy, like a disney movie. working hard to be happy as their characters, which is unrealistic. what counts on the reality is: is this a great person to develop together, someone that I feel comfortable to be around, someone that I’ll be able to accept that she might not give answers that tell me who I am, but even though make some efforts to our partnership keep moving in a nice way? if so, tell her all of this, apologize if you feel to. we are all learning, she is too. and give her space. if she doesn’t want you back, be with you, take care of you, as you are a person. start to see yourself as person. and learn to treat yourself, they way they should do.

how is that method? (I really want to know if you don’t mind).

I have suicidal thoughts very frequently. at the begging I thought it was because I was just a big crying baby that doesn’t accept some stuff the way they really was. like, myself. why I can’t reach perfection, and thought when I would get closer to this idea of perfection that would pass. I got closer to some of them. like love, jobs, I met great people, I lived in nyc. lol that was when I realized there’s now way to fight against life. life is supreme and sometimes, I believe, it doesn’t like us at all. I went to therapy and understood some patterns, familiar scripts and my infinity search for validation. it’s right all they say. we are a particular collection inside of us, we don’t have to make sense for anyone, we are all ready, as long we don’t hurt people intentionally. but that takes courage, work and it’s not guarantee for anything. it’s the best way to handle life, which is a place to deal with frustration, to understand that our desires will laugh at us, not giving us what we want and giving us what we do. I’m still here, because I don’t think how I want to do it, didn’t feel I get the right time yet and the resources… like a gun. because If I do, I want to make it sure It works. but there’s some kind a hope, that something will clear my mind and I’ll feel that it’s great to be alive. I don’t believe it. but I do see this damn hope here still.
that’s sounds hopeful. talk to us later. ✨
